# Run a paid customer acquisition experiment

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a defined customer segment and acquisition hypothesis are ready for a limited paid test. A reconciled experiment result with a documented continue, revise or stop decision.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Define the hypothesis and measurement plan

agent-runnable


State the segment, message, channel, desired action and attribution window. Record the baseline and separate leading indicators from actual revenue or retained customers.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve claims, targeting and spend

human · human approval required


The marketing owner approves the budget, creative claims and audience choices. Review privacy, advertising and platform restrictions for the intended markets and leave unsubstantiated claims out of the test.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Configure the approved campaign and tracking

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators set spending limits, destinations and consent-aware measurement. Test the landing and payment journey and confirm a clear stop mechanism before launch.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Monitor performance and data quality

agent-runnable


Reconcile spend, valid conversions and downstream customer outcomes. Investigate tracking gaps, fraud and support burden instead of optimizing only for clicks or a platform-reported conversion count.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Review the commercial outcome

human · human approval required


Compare observed acquisition cost and customer value with the hypothesis and cash exposure. Approve any scaling separately, stop weak tests and document the evidence for the next experiment.

- Verify: A reconciled experiment result with a documented continue, revise or stop decision.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GitLab customer success management handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-experience/csm/)
